steps.name: Color of emotion (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Minuet] in 「Adrika」 and defeat [Requiem] in 「Tree of God Lapier」 to obtain <Purple Hourglass>. Go back to [Minuet] and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, is that okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You don't have to worry anymore. From the moment %s returned from Pneuma, Gaia was worried about Iris... . Everything is okay now.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Pneuma's energy isn't bad, but I didn't know what effect it would have on those who felt it right away.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's okay now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. Then I will go… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Didn’t you come to me because you had something to say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just came here to check on the status.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I see... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This time, I have something to say on the contrary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer brought something back from his visit to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: I think something that should be in Pneuma came here with %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't remember bringing it with me. If there was such a thing, Iris would have told you about it... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Pneuma is a place where the energy of the ancient gods remains... . Iris may not have felt it. Now you will find out.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If that item gets into the hands of those who deny God, it can be misused. So, I would like to ask you to collect it, would you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I brought it, I'll come find it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: If I have it, it will be fine because its power doesn't reach here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should you look for?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Hourglass… . It is an hourglass of various colors containing various emotions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It's different from the hourglass you saw in Pneuma. I'm not sure why it came... . I would like to ask you to retrieve it. I think it will take a long time to find it.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: It probably flowed to an area where a strong force stayed... . If you find one first, you will be able to find the other.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: There is one near here… .
(Minuet quietly looks in the direction of Lapier.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: A feeling of purification... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come right away.

lines.speaker: 미네에트
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm here, Minuet.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Was it difficult to find it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was able to find it quickly because the purple sand was sparkling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not a common item, is it?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes.
(Minuet takes the purple hourglass from %s.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The energy of unrefined pneuma... . Although it's not a bad item, it doesn't fit here.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The purple sand contained therein contains a feeling of purification, hoping to purify the body and mind.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: This is the feeling that the ancient gods wanted for the world.
(As Minuet closes her eyes, the purple sand in the hourglass shakes and disappears little by little.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Gaia would also like this hourglass to be used like this. Iris I’m sure you feel this way too… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now where should I find the rest?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That's me too... . I'm not sure!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: The reason I could feel this was because the hourglass was nearby.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: But I can't go out of Adrica, so I guess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are so few clues. Where should I go... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Then I will tell you about the feelings in the hourglass… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Passion and love, prosperity and vitality, happiness, hope and peace, stability and harmony, and a heart for others.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You can find a place that suits the remaining six emotions... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems too vague, but... . When it comes to stability and harmony, there is something that comes to mind. Harmonia... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: You don't have to bring me that hourglass there. Harmonia will handle the hourglass as Harmonia does.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: … Gaia will guide you, so don't worry too much.
(Minuet smiles softly. It still looks expressionless, but for some reason, I feel joy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go there and look for it.

steps.name: Color of emotions (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Order] in the “Frozen World” and obtain the <Blue Hourglass>. Then, report the quest to [Harmonia], who has 「Belos of memories」.

lines.text: (Harmonia looks slightly surprised at the appearance of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Harmonia. But why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's been a while since I've seen you, and I'm sorry for greeting you with a surprised expression.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's definitely Adventurer, but I feel the energy from somewhere else. If there is a place full of spirits other than here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, so you were surprised. Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Harmonia the story related to the hourglass.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Ah… . That's because you went to Pneuma. The feeling of this place was already strange.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The spirits here were preparing to go somewhere else and became agitated, and there was a reason for this.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hmm… .
(Harmonia holds the necklace and quietly looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It seems like the hourglass there fell in a place where cold energy was felt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the frozen world… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If that were the case, the ancient gods' desire for harmony and stability would be conveyed to Iris.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: This is an item that spirits cannot touch, so please bring it to me, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come right away.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes… . Then be careful.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: %s, did you have a good time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was able to find it without difficulty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on here?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Could you please give me an hourglass first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. uh?
(As Harmonia extends her right hand holding the necklace, the hourglass in %s's hand slowly rises.)
(At Harmonia's hand gesture, the glass of the hourglass cracks, and blue sand falls through the crack and scatters somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: This is the feeling of stability and harmony that I hoped for in Pneuma... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The gods must have looked at spirits and life with these emotions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pneuma… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, by the way, I told you that the spirits go somewhere else. What's going on in the world of images?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's not like there's anything big going on. Now, Iris’s mental world will get smaller little by little… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Since Iris has ascended to the position of Star God, there is less reason to maintain this place.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Evil Order also disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see… . I understood.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geas and I are sending the spirits here to other places. If this place disappears little by little, we will have to go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do the spirits go?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Well… . If there is a place that needs us, we will naturally go to that place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Now where can I find the remaining hourglass... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It seems that the hourglass flowed into Adrika and Iris's mental world following the spirit's energy.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: … I guess I have to go out and find what's left. Get help from the spirits you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirit… . Ah, Monster Tree Mountain… !

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you are Lapidem outside, you will be able to help us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I had to go say hello. Harmonia, see you later.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Okay, see you somewhere new. I will go help other spirits with their work.
(Harmonia bows and slowly walks towards the burning city.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: New place... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you said you were somewhere else besides here, I guess you're going there, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, let's go straight to Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's a warm day, so I think I'll fall asleep.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, you can't fall asleep, so you have to stay alert. It's scary to think that I fell asleep for a moment before and then Arborum appeared.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, you're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lapidem. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm doing well. I have heard about you before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry for not being able to visit you for a while.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's okay. It's okay. If you're busy, you can do that. After receiving so much trust, they almost didn't recognize my face because I couldn't even lift my nose.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Just kidding. It's not something else, it's the Goddess' work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I just thought it was sincere...)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Have you been to Pneuma? Even if you don't draw it, the spirits that Harmonia taught you will wander around and tell you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I have something to talk about with Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Lapidem that you went to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Weaver Gya was there. I heard that Gaia took it away.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Do you want to know where the hourglass you brought back with you is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I want to borrow Lapidem’s wisdom.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What is wisdom? It's just that I lived a little longer. Let’s see, what’s left… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Prosperity and vitality are the money people talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe something like that, right?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then the answer came. Is there a son around here who is crazy about money? The son who chases after the cat he is about to meet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, a mercenary group?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That Parmilla… That kid called. It comes often and you don't even know it's a spirit. I'm praying. Spirit, please take good care of our mercenary group and let us make a lot of money.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I came and went earlier too. Then I take the flowers in front of me one by one, and, Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know what it was, but I had a strange feeling, but I guess it was the hourglass. I think it was probably in the flower that Parmilla Gya took.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: If the desire for money is so strong, the item goes to the person... Well, it's not normal either.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: %s, whatever. Well, I have to go. If you go to a place where the flower still has evil traces, you will be in big trouble.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Quickly ask the mercenary group Gya and find him! Bring me whatever you find. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes! I will!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s go straight to Parmilla.)

steps.name: Color of emotions (6)
steps.objective: Defeat [Retum] at “Warriors’ Rest” and obtain <Orange Hourglass>. Then report the quest to [Rapidem] in “Monster Tree Mountain.”

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, the work entrusted to you has been completed to some extent.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then shall we go now? Let's leave this to Arcane for the time being.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Heading to Glaston?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No. I have work to do before that. Because Calone needs to be freed from the scrutiny of the council.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What are you thinking now? A passing cat, Calone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: At that time, I was so surprised to see the princess that I was speechless. How long do you plan on teasing me about that?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, until I die?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Daeuanjaang… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone. Wait, shh.
(Calone nods at Parmilla’s gesture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, you two. long time no see.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I… . Nothing special happened here, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What has to happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, not necessarily… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s There is a saying that there will always be accidents on the way.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Just hearing about the things that the Empire is paying attention to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not some kind of detective, not to that extent.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just kidding. joke. What are you looking for, right? That's because I'm looking around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did you put the flowers you brought from Monster Tree Mountain?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Flowers? Oh, that? I brought it carefully because it looked pretty, but it doesn't work?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like that, because I need it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah? I brought it here in hopes of making a lot of money, but there is nothing I can do about it. I placed it in the center of the Belkia Kingdom military cemetery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Parmilla!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I guess it's urgent. Is it okay to run that fast?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I guess that's because they are a different type of person than us. Directly connected to God... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, what's wrong with us? Be confident.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now we're going to find the people hiding in Freios that the council is paying attention to. Only then will we be able to find out what the Magic Agency is hiding.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yeah. are you okay. Anyway, there is someone I need to meet at least once.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: … Are you from His Majesty’s side?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It may be so, but... . Oops, I'll tell you later. Should we pack our bags first?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Okay… .
(Orange light flows through as many flowers as there are tombstones in the warriors' rest area.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here it is! Orange hourglass... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's nice to see the hourglass appear, but why did it appear here?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you think about it for a long time, you won't come up with an answer, so let's just go to Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: When I look at the sky, it doesn't look out of the ordinary. It’s different from the sky I’ve seen so far… . Oh, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I found it right away and brought it to you. But what were you saying to yourself?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Something feels strange... . Maybe it's because a lot of hidden spirits came out... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (This is not the same feeling I had when I met Agashura...)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Anyway… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, you brought back the hourglass that I thought had soaked into the flower? Well, that's it. If you leave it in front of me, it will disappear on its own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here… .
(As Lapidem said, I put down the hourglass and waited, and the flowers around me started blooming and falling repeatedly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, he disappeared without a trace.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Still, I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But the hourglass. I don't know if he found something to give him prosperity and vitality, or who made him change.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Imagine if that power went into the grave. There are only a few Belkian soldiers left, but if they wander around Mirgandia, it will be a hassle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, it's not difficult to retrieve it, but it's a lot.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I can't help it. Now that it's your job... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But now where do we find the rest?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm, well… . You can go find another spirit you know.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What remains is passion, love, happiness, hope and peace, and a heart for someone... . 4 items?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, by the way, the only spirit you can meet right away is Narin.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, Narin. Narin… ! Gya is the spirit king of water and ice? That child is waiting for you right now. So go there quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know? Narin said he would wait for me... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's a spirit. You are human. Don't you draw it? Spirits have something in common with each other.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I guess so.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then, go to Narin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will go right away. sorry. I will come back often in the future.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Do you like what you just tried? it's okay. It's okay.  See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Narin is waiting, what kind of hourglass is there...? Should we go first?)

steps.name: Color of emotions (8)
steps.objective: Defeat [Liriope] in “Fountain of Echoes” and obtain <Indigo Hourglass>. Then report the quest to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, welcome back!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew I was here.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The spirits were agitated and recognized my limited abilities. I noticed that something not from this world fell around here.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Still, it had a similar energy to mine, and I could feel Gaia's hand on it, so I was just watching.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I've been waiting for Adventurer thanks to a person called Elder Spirit who sent me a message from afar.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Adventurer, can you explain the place you visited?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Narin the story of his visit to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I feel nostalgic for some reason... .
(As Narin continues the story, tears form around her eyes little by little and fall. The fallen tears turn into ice crystals and fly away somewhere with the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I apologize. I didn't mean to do this... . I just felt a sense of comfort towards someone. ah!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It feels like I'm outside the village. Where great power resided, that object... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If there was a place with great power outside the village... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It must be a fountain of echoes. Perhaps the object will only be visible to Adventurer because it came into this world with Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will find it right away and bring it to Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Narin, I will be waiting with a happy heart.
(Narin looks at the hourglass she received from %s.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This navy blue hourglass… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: … Emotions are fluctuating within me. For life... . Perhaps it is the nature of life to serve others rather than oneself.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It is also connected to the emotions that the ancient gods had.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If the power of this hourglass were passed on to the Goddess, it would be of great help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Just doing your job. I apologize. Then, I will handle the task as if I were melting ice at once.
(Narin unfolds the scroll and places a navy blue hourglass on it.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Narinnarinnaririn!
(As Narin chants the spell, the hourglass slowly seeps into the scroll like powder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Every time I hear this spell, I can't get used to it.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You should listen to it a thousand times more. That way you get used to it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Do I really need to listen to that much?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, this is the end for today. I think this feeling will be of great help to the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Because this scroll was given by God... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. Thanks to the spirits, I collected a lot. But I have no idea where to find the rest.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Iris You may also be wondering how to find it. We continue to need the help of the spirits.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What kind of spirits do what... . Narin will also help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris must be a lot of trouble too...)

lines.text: Please don't worry too much. Io and I will find out the whereabouts of the hourglass in various ways, so please wait.

lines.text: Thank you, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: No. Then, I have some work to do, so I will leave now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t have a clue, but I have no choice but to gather clues...)
